'''Debreceni Vasutas Sport Club''' is a Hungarian professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Debrecen]] that competes in the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság I]], the first tier of [[Hungarian football league system|Hungarian football]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/teams/52958--debrecen/|title=Debreceni VSC|date=15 July 2014|publisher=UEFA|access-date=15 July 2014|archive-date=12 July 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240712165953/https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/teams/52958--debrecen/|url-status=live}}</ref> They are best known internationally for reaching the group stages of the [[UEFA Champions League]] in the [[2009–10 UEFA Champions League|2009–10 season]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=2010/clubs/index.html|title=2009–10 UEFA Champions League: Clubs|date=15 July 2014|publisher=UEFA|access-date=15 July 2014|archive-date=1 September 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140901110248/http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=2010/clubs/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> Debrecen have become the second most successful club in Hungary since 2000, winning the Hungarian League seven times.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesh/hongchamp.html|title=Hungarian League winners|date=15 July 2014|publisher=The Rec Sport Soccer Statistics Foundation|access-date=2 February 2023|archive-date=3 February 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230203030545/https://rsssf.org/tablesh/hongchamp.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
{{see also|2026–27 Debreceni VSC season}}"}}
